name: Google Analytics
summary: Ask about your Google Analytics 4 traffic: reports, live visitors and metrics.
description: Ask VoiceOS about your website or app traffic in Google Analytics 4: visitors, page views, top pages, sources and countries for any date range, compared with an earlier period, and who is on your site right now. Read-only. Connects to your Google account through Composio (OAuth2).

preferences.name: COMPOSIO_API_KEY
preferences.title: Composio API key (temporary, for testing)
preferences.description: Temporary field for testing; it will be removed before release. Leave blank to use COMPOSIO_API_KEY from the integration's .env.

blocks.text: Google Analytics → Admin → Property → Property details → PROPERTY ID. (Digits only. Not the G-… Measurement ID.)

tools.name: run_report
tools.title: Run report
tools.description: Visitors, page views, top pages and sources for any date range.

property_id.description: GA4 property ID (digits, e.g. 123456789). Omit to use the default from Setup.

metrics.description: Metric API names to count, 1 to 10, e.g. ["activeUsers"]

dimensions.description: Dimension API names to group by, up to 9, e.g. ["pagePath"]. Omit for totals only.

compare_start_date.description: Start of an earlier period to compare with, same formats. Set together with compare_end_date.

compare_end_date.description: End of the earlier period to compare with.

dimension.description: Dimension API name, e.g. "country" or "eventName". It need not be in dimensions.

value.description: Exact value to keep, e.g. "United States" or "sign_up_click".

filter.description: Keep only rows where this dimension equals this value.

order_by.description: A metric or dimension from this request to sort by. Default: the first metric.

descending.description: Sort high to low (default true). Use false for dates in time order.

limit.description: Maximum rows (default 10). totals and row_count always cover every matching row.

tools.name: run_realtime_report
tools.title: Run realtime report
tools.description: See who's on your site right now and which pages they're on.

property_id.description: GA4 property ID (digits, e.g. 123456789). Omit to use the default from Setup.

metrics.description: Metric API names, up to 10. Default ["activeUsers"].

dimensions.description: Dimension API names to group by, up to 9, e.g. ["unifiedScreenName"]. Omit for totals only.

dimension.description: Dimension API name, e.g. "country" or "eventName". It need not be in dimensions.

value.description: Exact value to keep, e.g. "United States" or "sign_up_click".

filter.description: Keep only rows where this dimension equals this value.

order_by.description: A metric or dimension from this request to sort by. Default: the first metric.

descending.description: Sort high to low (default true). Use false for dates in time order.

limit.description: Maximum rows (default 10). totals and row_count always cover every matching row.

tools.name: get_metadata
tools.title: Get metadata
tools.description: List the metrics and dimensions you can ask about.

property_id.description: GA4 property ID (digits, e.g. 123456789). Omit to use the default from Setup.

category.description: Only this category, e.g. "Page / Screen", "User", "Session", "Geography", "Traffic Source", "Event".

search.description: Only fields whose API or display name contains these words, e.g. "view".
